name: btn: Open Customer In QBO
purpose: Opens the customer in QuickBooks Online: takes the QBO id of the customer's external link and calls LedgerLink 'Open in QB' with entity Customer.
open_question: Browser opening happens in the LedgerLink script, outside this share.

name: btn: Delete SalesTransaction From Customer
purpose: Deletes a sales transaction from a customer: does nothing when the transaction already has a QBO id, otherwise asks karbon_kontroller to delete it and shows a success or error message (billable time goes back to unbilled).
writes: delete: SalesTransaction (via karbon_kontroller script 560 'Delete SalesTransaction', step 7, by id)
open_question: $result is tested at step 8 but never set from Get(ScriptResult), so the error branch can never run and the user always sees success. No caller found, not even a layout button.

name: btn: Open Create Party Card - Customer
purpose: Opens the create-party card flagged as a customer: clears the selected party, installs a timer to jump to the customer detail once the party is created, then opens the card.
calls:
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/184 step 7
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/614 step 5 (Install OnTimer Script, interval 1)

name: Go to Customer { Id }_deprecated
purpose: Deprecated: finds a customer by Id on the Customer Detail layout. In the target the effect owner would be server-query.
open_question: Name ends with _deprecated; no caller found. Does not restore the original layout.

name: OnTimer: Handle Create Party From Customer
purpose: Timer handler: stops the timer, then goes to the detail page of the customer just created from the create-party card, using the new party role id.
